bruno-fernandes/bruno_02_should-have-gon.text: What am I even doing here? Saudi Arabia offered me sunshine and probably a striker. No left back, no striker. I should have gone to Saudi.

So we know they're dangerous from set pieces and the plan is hope they don't get one. Brilliant, absolutely brilliant. We had 70% possession, we lost 2-0. Two set pieces, two goals. The exact thing we talked about before the game. So, newly promoted Hull, two set pieces, no goals. Harry, you're a centre-back. And somehow you were the one having shots. What are we actually doing here? Saudi Arabia offered me sunshine, they probably had a striker as well. Can somebody check if Saudi are still calling? I should have went to Saudi.

jim-ratcliffe/jim_01_bigger-issues-facin.text: We need to focus on the bigger issues facing Britain. Standards, discipline, efficiency. Everyone always wants more players. Sometimes you have to make do with what you've got.

jim-ratcliffe/jim_02_i-live-in-monaco.mp.text: That's how you build character and save money. Yes. I live in Monaco. That's completely different. It gives me an outside perspective.

jim-ratcliffe/jim_03_excellent-business-.text: Anyway, three midfielders sounds like excellent business. Good meeting. Good meeting.

narrator/narrator_01_deadline-day-intro..text: Manchester United, transfer deadline day. The manager asked for two players. He got three midfielders. Nobody appears entirely sure why. This is all or something.

narrator/narrator_02_everything-except-w.text: Everything except what the manager actually asked for.

narrator/narrator_03_new-season-hull-sam.text: New season. New Manchester United. Probably. Hull City. Newly promoted. Physical. Aggressive. Dangerous from set pieces. Manchester United knew exactly what was coming. It did not help. Hull City 2. Manchester United 0. 70% possession, zero points. New season, same corners. This is All or Something.

omar-berrada/omar_01_market-presented-op.text: Yeah, but three midfielders. We felt the market presented opportunities and we took those opportunities. Were they the positions we needed? No.

omar-berrada/omar_02_efficient-recruitme.text: But they were available. Who's scoring the goals? Bruno. He's already here, so technically that's efficient recruitment. Left back, we have internal solutions.

steve-holland/steve_01_practise-defendin.text: Should we practise defending those then? That was attacking corners. Michael, wrong door. Excellent. Less excellent. Good news, we've got Ipswich next.
